The '''Eternal Fleet reprisal bombardments''' were a series of bombardments carries out by the [[Eternal Fleet]] against five inhabited worlds in [[3630 BBY]]. Following the [[Battle of Asylum]] Emperor [[Arcann]] of the [[Eternal Empire]] ordered the search for the [[Gravestone]] and [[Alliance Commander|The Commander]] that resulted in no leads. Trying to lure them out, he ordered [[High Justice]] [[Vaylin]] to use the [[Eternal Fleet]] against five different inhabitant planets in different sectors. The order was carried out and the worlds were bombed to dust, with whole cities leveled and civilian death toll counted in millions.<ref name="Chapter 10" />

==Behind the scenes==
Eternal Fleet reprisal bombardments appear in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' '''Chapter X: Anarchy In Paradise'''.
